clauses.assertion: An authorized shared backend with the exact candidate migration, club scope, monitoring and rollback controls must host the synchronized session.
Two independently connected physical phones must join the same session; the current preflight found no available physical phone and one paired iPhone that was unavailable.
A physical native-TV target must render the same session; an Android TV emulator does not satisfy this clause.
Privacy-safe logs from both phones, native TV, Admin and backend must correlate one club-scoped session and exact candidate build set.
All participating surfaces must demonstrate the same authoritative phase, session version, question version and ordered event sequence through the required journey.
The real session must record server-correlated timing, latency, connection loss, reconnect, stale-event rejection and recovery without inferring network behavior from deterministic tests.
Timestamped privacy-safe device and backend logs plus continuous video must identify the exact builds, devices and complete synchronized journey.
Named privacy, accessibility, QA, operations and release owners must accept the physical-session evidence and any retained risks.
